info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Reopens-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Reopen Query API allows users to efficiently retrieve a list of tickets that have been reopened for further review or resolution. This API enables support teams to monitor ongoing issues and track the status of reopened tickets, enhancing customer support and operational transparency. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and systems that integrate support ticket management functionalities. By using this endpoint, organizations can ensure timely follow-ups and resolutions for customer queries.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to reopen a ticket that has been closed. It is useful for situations where further action is required on a ticket that was previously resolved.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to reopen a previously closed ticket. It requires specific parameters in the JSON format to identify the ticket that needs to be reopened.

200.description: The request to reopen the ticket was successful.

ListSupportTicketsReopensRequest.description: Request Body for the operation to reopen tickets. This is expected to carry the reason or context for reopening a ticket.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_200.title: Ticket Reopen Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket was successfully reopened.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the reopen operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after the reopen operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the reopen operation.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response returned when a ticket is successfully reopened.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The username of the person or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains audit details related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total processing time for the request to complete, measured in milliseconds.

schema.description: The time taken in milliseconds to process the request.
